description: This file defines the 'vrb_alloc' structure for resource block allocation in a wireless communication scheduler, including methods for creating, copying, and querying resource allocations, as well as conversion functions and formatting support.

classes.name: vrb_alloc
classes.description: Represents a resource block allocation that can be of type 0 (set of RBGs) or type 1 (VRB range), with methods for managing and querying the allocation.

methods.name: convert_rbgs_to_prbs
methods.description: Converts RBG bitmap to PRB bitmap given BWP PRB dimensions and RBG size.
